sections.title: 2. Scope, Definitions & Account Responsibilities
sections.content:
“Product” means the downloadable digital files described in a listing; “order” means your recorded purchase request; “delivery” means purchased download access being made available electronically in your account; “you” means the purchasing customer. No physical product is shipped.

You must provide accurate email and contact details during account creation or checkout. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials, password and access links private. Notify us immediately of suspected unauthorized access. You agree to use the service in compliance with applicable law.

sections.title: 3. Pre-Purchase Requirements & Technical Description
sections.content:
Review the product description, tech stack, included files, dependencies, installation requirements, limitations, and license before paying. You must ensure your development environment or hosting platform meets the published technical specifications. Contact us before purchase if a requirement or permitted use is unclear.

We maintain listing standards that accurately describe included templates, source files, and dependencies. Minor visual variances or third-party package updates that do not impact core functionality do not constitute a defect.

sections.title: 4. Orders, Payments & Verification
sections.content:
Prices are displayed in INR and the final payable total, including any applicable charges, is presented before payment. We do not add undisclosed mandatory charges after purchase.

A browser success screen, screenshot or debit SMS alone does not confirm payment. We verify payment using trusted server-side webhooks and API checks with the provider selected at checkout: Cashfree, Razorpay or Easebuzz, where configured and approved. Download access is granted only after the payment provider confirms a successful payment matching the order. Failed, cancelled, pending, test or unverified transactions do not unlock a paid product.

Products marked “By BooyahMarket” are our own products. Independent creator sales are enabled only after platform review and the relevant payment provider’s marketplace/submerchant activation. Where enabled, the payment provider handles the approved split and settlement arrangement. A marketplace approval is distinct from ordinary payment-gateway approval. We do not offer a customer wallet, stored value or unlicensed money transfer service.

sections.title: 5. Digital Product Delivery, Access & Download Records
sections.content:
Delivery is electronic only. No physical shipping, courier delivery or shipping fee applies. After successful payment verification, the purchased files are normally available immediately in your account → Downloads. Please allow up to 24 hours if payment confirmation or file preparation is delayed. A pending bank debit is not a verified payment.

We send an order confirmation to the email address used at checkout, with a link to the purchased downloads in your account. Sign in with the same email to access your order, receipts and eligible files. Email delivery may be delayed or filtered to spam; your account remains the main place to get your files. Download links are protected and may expire; request a new link from your account when required.

If a verified purchase is still unavailable after 24 hours, contact connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 7393845435 with your order reference. We aim to correct a reported delivery failure within 72 hours. If we cannot provide the advertised files or a prompt resolution, you may choose a replacement or a refund under the Refund, Cancellation & Payment Policy. This support window does not require you to wait to report the issue or postpone a remedy required by law.

We keep electronic records of payment verification, email status, download-link creation and available file-access events, including timestamps and relevant security information, to support orders, license compliance and dispute review. A generated link, an email accepted by the delivery provider or a browser redirect alone does not prove that a customer downloaded or received a file.

Your purchase grants a non-exclusive license to use and customize the listed files for the personal or commercial use specified in the product listing and included license. It does not transfer underlying intellectual property or copyright ownership. Review the listing before purchase; contact us if your intended use is unclear.

You may edit the source for the permitted project. Unless an applicable license expressly allows it, you must not resell, relicense, sublicense, share or redistribute the proprietary source package, publish it as a competing downloadable template, or provide public access to the paid files. Third-party and open-source components keep their own license terms, copyright notices and permissions; those terms govern those components.

When your verified payment is accepted, the purchase forms a license contract between you and the publisher named on the listing and order, on the product-specific license and these published terms. For products published by BooyahMarket, MANISH KUMAR SONKAR is that publisher. For independent creator products, the named creator supplies and licenses the product; BooyahMarket operates the marketplace, checkout and protected delivery. This allocation does not remove the platform’s own obligations, published grievance support, eligible refund remedies or non-excludable consumer rights. Publisher business and support details are available on the creator storefront. If a product-specific license is unclear or conflicts with mandatory law, contact support before buying.

sections.title: 8. Acceptable Use & Prohibited Conduct
sections.content:
This marketplace is for lawful, rights-cleared digital products within the approved business category. You must not list, upload, sell, link to or use the checkout to facilitate:
• Pirated, cracked, stolen or unauthorized copyrighted software/media, license keys, copied templates, circumvention tools, counterfeits or another creator’s paid package without sufficient rights.
• Malware, ransomware, phishing kits, credential theft, unauthorized hacking/access tools, stolen accounts, passwords, government identity documents, personal-data dumps or mailing lists; bulk-spam tools and unsolicited-message products.
• Child sexual abuse/exploitation material, pornography or sexually explicit services, trafficking, abusive or unlawful hate/violence content, and material that violates another person’s privacy or safety.
• Weapons, ammunition, explosives, illegal drugs or controlled substances, body parts, prohibited wildlife products, alcohol/tobacco or other physical/regulated goods outside this digital-only store.
• Gambling, betting, real-money gaming or chance-based paid schemes; deceptive prize/mystery-box schemes, money laundering, pyramid/MLM collection fees, get-rich-quick or fraudulent investment/earnings claims.
• Unlicensed financial, lending, investment, money-transfer, currency/crypto or stored-value/gift-card products; regulated advice or other services for which the required authorization and provider approval have not been established.
• Fake qualifications/certificates, identity impersonation, deceptive job-placement or paid-employment promises, unsubstantiated medical/miracle-cure claims, or other fraudulent or unlawful products.

This is a platform restriction list, not a statement that every named category is illegal in every context. Provider restrictions may prohibit a lawful category or require separate written approval. Cashfree, Razorpay and Easebuzz have their own current negative/restricted categories and submerchant rules. The stricter applicable legal/provider/platform rule governs a sale. Changing gateways does not make a rejected category acceptable, and generic payment-gateway activation does not approve digital downloads, third-party aggregation or recurring products. Ask support before listing an uncertain category. A licence or open-source permission must actually cover the proposed sale; legitimate third-party components may retain their own notices and permissions.

sections.title: 9. Fraud Prevention, Transaction Security & Action
sections.content:
We monitor available payment, order and account records for fraud or abuse. We distinguish a credible risk signal from a final finding and preserve lawful buyer and seller remedies.

Credible excessive chargebacks, suspected illegal products, identity/payment irregularities or a legal complaint can trigger a documented review. We may pause the affected listings or new sales and restrict the affected seller’s access where justified. A complaint alone is not a finding of guilt, and an open dispute is not automatically a proven fraud. Ordinary buyer purchase accounts are not required to provide seller PAN merely because they bought a product.

Where our approved provider arrangement and applicable law permit a reserve, the affected/proportionate unsettled exposure may be placed under review with an initial target review period of up to 120 calendar days from the restriction. The recorded case identifies the reason, affected amount/orders, start date, target review date and next action; we communicate the reason and review/appeal route unless law or a binding provider instruction prevents disclosure. The seller can submit evidence or challenge an error through the published support/grievance contact. We review the need for the restriction rather than treating 120 days as an automatic penalty or confiscation.

Expiry triggers a review of outstanding refunds, chargebacks, legal instructions and KYC requirements. If the issues are resolved and the provider permits release, the eligible balance can enter the provider-approved release process. An unresolved binding legal/provider hold does not disappear on day 120; a longer restriction needs a documented basis, updated review date and notice where permitted. We do not guarantee an automatic bank transfer exactly on day 120. Amounts no longer needed for a justified restriction should be released through the approved route. No arbitrary fine or forfeiture of all seller earnings is created by this policy.

sections.title: 10. Chargebacks, Payment Disputes & Evidence
sections.content:
If an order or payment is not right, please contact support so we can investigate and help promptly. You remain entitled to raise an unauthorized-payment complaint or dispute with your bank or payment provider; contacting us first is a request, not a condition on those rights.

When responding to a dispute, we may provide relevant order and payment records, support correspondence and available email/download-access records to the payment processor or financial institution. We distinguish payment confirmation, email-provider acceptance, link creation and recorded file access rather than treating them as the same event. The bank or payment provider decides the dispute under its rules.

sections.title: Subscriptions & Memberships
sections.content:
Creator plans are ₹499 per month for up to 10 new product creations in each verified paid monthly billing period, or ₹899 per month with no product-count limit. The ₹499 plan includes the published storefront, secure product delivery, order management and basic earnings tools; the ₹899 plan includes the available seller tools and customer-membership offer creation. It does not grant platform-admin access. A product created as a draft counts toward the 10-product allowance; deleting, archiving or replacing it does not restore that period’s allowance. A renewed verified paid period has its own allowance. Existing order and subscription snapshots remain tied to the offer accepted at purchase.

Unlimited refers to product count, not unlimited storage, bandwidth or file size. Each product archive is limited to 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes), and the disclosed available storage and technical limits still apply. The price, features, interval, renewal mode and any applicable taxes or mandatory charges are shown before payment. We do not sell a provider approval or a guarantee of sales as a plan benefit.

Creator paid plans provide the published platform features and listing limits. Customer memberships provide access only to the named creator’s eligible products for the verified paid period; they do not include every product or transfer copyright. The plan, INR price, interval, renewal mode, access period and any applicable fees are displayed before payment. Draft or disabled plans cannot be purchased.

Automatic renewal is available only where the provider’s approved subscription/mandate flow is explicitly offered and accepted. A manual-renewal plan requires a fresh payment and does not charge automatically. Changing the default gateway does not move an existing mandate to another provider. You can request cancellation from Memberships or the creator plan controls. A pending cancellation is shown until confirmed with the original provider. Cancellation stops future renewals once confirmed; already-paid access normally continues to the verified period end. Failed, test, pending or merely authorized mandates do not grant paid benefits. Independent one-time purchases retain their own access rights. Eligible refund and statutory rights remain governed by the refund policy.

sections.title: Creator Publishing, Review & Settlements
sections.content:
Creators must be adults able to contract, own or hold sufficient rights to each product, provide the required public business/support disclosures, complete seller-only KYC and accept the current Creator Agreement before selling. New listings and their private files require review.

For an independent creator sale, the platform commission is a flat ₹20 per successfully paid digital item, recorded in paise with the order; digital products are purchased once per item per order. For example, two paid items have a ₹40 platform commission. This platform fee is separate from the creator-plan subscription. Any applicable provider charges, taxes, lawful deductions and their treatment must be disclosed through the approved arrangement; they are not described as included in ₹20 unless explicitly stated. An item cannot create a negative seller allocation. A coupon or price that cannot support the recorded allocation must be corrected before checkout. Confirmed refunds, reversals and lost disputes adjust the affected allocation under the original order and provider rules. No record may claim a bank credit merely because a payable balance exists.

For eligible independent-creator proceeds, our standard target is release eligibility 3 calendar days (72 hours) after the verified successful live payment and digital access have been provided. The review window helps us check delivery issues, payment disputes and complaints. It is not a promise that every dispute appears within three days or that no later chargeback can occur.

Settlement is handled through the payment provider’s approved marketplace/split arrangement. Where an approved hold-and-release API is activated, scheduled processing can request release after eligibility; otherwise the case requires the supported provider-dashboard process. We do not claim to operate a customer wallet, bank account or escrow service in our own capacity. Provider, legal, KYC, refund and risk restrictions take precedence over our target. A release request, a ledger entry and a provider-accepted transfer are distinct from confirmed bank credit. Bank holidays, provider cutoffs, outages and beneficiary checks can extend arrival time. Bank settlement goes to the seller’s verified registered payout account. UPI payout is available only if the separately approved provider product supports and verifies that destination; it is not a simultaneous second payment of the same proceeds.

sections.title: Product Files, Uploads & Direct Links
sections.content:
Product archives must be ZIP files no larger than 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes). Uploads are sent directly to private Supabase Storage using a short-lived authorized upload route, then checked server-side and held for review. Approved product delivery uses the private product area and short-lived account-authorized download links; files are not published as open website assets.

A seller may instead submit an eligible public HTTPS direct file link through the supported import flow. The link is subject to host/network safety checks, file-type and actual-size checks, timeout limits and private copying before review. Login pages, ordinary web pages, link shorteners, private/internal network addresses, unsafe redirects and files over the limit are not accepted. Submitting an external URL is not approval, delivery or a download entitlement. Do not submit another person’s private files or credentials. Neither a paid plan nor a direct link bypasses ownership, content review, file limits or available storage capacity.

This Refund, Cancellation & Payment Policy governs all financial transactions, order cancellations, duplicate payment resolutions, and refund requests on BooyahMarket.

sections.title: 2. Digital Product Nature & General Refund Rule
sections.content:
BooyahMarket sells downloadable digital templates and source-code packages. They cannot be physically returned. A purchase is generally final once payment is confirmed and the advertised download access is made available in your account; change-of-mind or accidental-purchase refunds are generally unavailable after this point, whether or not you choose to download.

This general rule does not exclude a legitimate duplicate charge, missing or wrong files, material misdescription, unresolved major defect, non-delivery, unauthorized-payment rights or any remedy required by applicable law. Downloading a file does not waive these rights.

sections.title: 3. Eligible Refund Scenarios & Non-Delivery Situations
sections.content:
A replacement, correction or refund is available where the circumstances justify it:
• Non-delivery: A verified successful payment is recorded but we cannot provide the purchased files or promptly resolve an access failure. We aim to correct a reported delivery failure within 72 hours; if delivery cannot be remedied, you may choose a replacement or refund. This service window does not postpone any remedy required by law.
• Wrong or missing files / material misdescription: The supplied package materially differs from what the listing promised or lacks core files, and we cannot promptly supply the correct advertised package.
• Major defect: A critical defect prevents the advertised core use and we cannot provide a working fix or replacement.
• Duplicate charging: The payment provider confirms an extra successful charge for the same purchase. The extra charge is refunded without cancelling the valid original purchase.

Where only particular items are affected, we may agree an item-specific remedy or partial refund with you. Mandatory consumer remedies remain available.

sections.title: 4. Ineligible Scenarios & Download/Access Exceptions
sections.content:
A refund is generally not available solely because:
• You changed your mind after confirmed payment and digital access were provided.
• You need compatibility with an environment, feature or software version not promised in the listing.
• You need custom development or deployment skills beyond the product’s stated scope.

These exclusions do not apply when we supplied incorrect information, materially misdescribed the product, failed to provide the advertised files, or applicable law requires a remedy. We may ask for sufficient order details to identify the payment and investigate; if information is missing, we will explain what is needed rather than automatically treating the report as invalid.

sections.title: 5. Cancellation Prior to Digital Access
sections.content:
You can leave checkout or cancel an unpaid order before completing payment; no purchase is completed until payment succeeds. If a payment is debited but remains pending, contact us with the reference so we can check its status with Cashfree or the original payment provider. An unsettled or pending debit is not proof of a successful charge, and bank reversals follow the provider’s process.

After a successful payment and digital access have been provided, ordinary change-of-mind cancellation is generally unavailable. You may still request a remedy for non-delivery, duplicate payment, incorrect files, material defects or other qualifying circumstances above. We cannot guarantee that an in-progress bank payment can be stopped.

sections.title: 6. Duplicate Payments & Payment Error Processing
sections.content:
If you notice multiple successful debits for the same order, email connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com with your order ID, payment references and the dates and amounts debited. Mask unrelated bank or card information in any supporting image.

We check the records with Cashfree, or the original payment processor for an existing purchase. A verified extra charge is refunded through the original payment route after review. Refunding a duplicate charge does not cancel the valid original payment or the download access it purchased. Failed or pending debits are checked separately and follow the bank’s reversal process.

sections.title: 7. Refund Request Procedure & Review Timeline
sections.content:
Report an issue promptly, preferably within 7 days of purchase, by emailing connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com. Include:
1. Order ID and payment reference, if available
2. The email address used for the purchase
3. A clear explanation and relevant evidence of the delivery, file or payment issue

We review requests within 2 business days and ask for any missing information. After approval, we initiate the agreed refund within 5 business days through the original payment route and provide the available refund reference. Bank credit normally takes a further 5–7 business days after initiation, depending on the payment method, bank and provider; it may take longer during provider or banking delays. Contact us with the refund reference if the credit has not appeared. We do not promise instant bank credit.

A confirmed full refund removes access to the refunded purchase. A partial refund records the affected items and agreed access resolution; unrelated paid products remain available. A partial refund needing item allocation is reviewed before an item’s access is changed. We do not refund more than the successful amount paid for the affected purchase.

The suggested 7-day reporting period is not a limit on a statutory claim, an unauthorized-payment complaint or a remedy that applicable law requires. Business days mean Monday to Friday, excluding public and bank holidays.

sections.title: 8. Payment Gateways, Verification & Transaction Security
sections.content:
Cashfree, Razorpay or Easebuzz processes the purchase using the provider shown at checkout. Each payment, refund, dispute and subscription renewal remains with its original provider even if the site’s default gateway later changes. Payment details are entered on the provider’s checkout. BooyahMarket verifies the payment on the server before granting paid access.

If money is debited but your order is pending, contact us with the order/payment reference. We reconcile the provider’s status; a merchant-side verification error does not itself prove payment success or automatically initiate a refund. Failed-payment reversals follow the provider and bank process. Test transactions do not create a real purchase or unlock paid files.

sections.title: 9. Interaction with Chargebacks & Payment Disputes
sections.content:
We encourage you to contact support so payment and delivery issues can be investigated quickly. This does not restrict your right to raise a complaint or dispute with your bank or payment provider.

If a bank dispute and a refund request concern the same payment, we coordinate with the payment provider to avoid duplicate credit. Processing may need to follow the bank’s dispute process, and we will explain the known status. This does not remove any remedy or timeline required by applicable law.

sections.title: Subscription Cancellation & Refunds
sections.content:
Cancel a creator paid plan or customer membership from its account controls to stop future renewal. Automatic renewal cancellation is confirmed with the original provider; an unsuccessful or pending cancellation requires follow-up with support. A manual plan never automatically charges again. Cancelling a plan does not itself refund a completed billing period. Ordinary change of mind after digital access is provided is generally ineligible, while duplicate charges, non-delivery, material defects, incorrect charges and non-excludable statutory remedies remain eligible for review. A confirmed refund or chargeback may revoke the affected subscription period or products; unrelated valid one-time purchases remain available. Creator plan allowances follow the verified paid monthly period: 10 new creations for ₹499, or no product-count limit for ₹899, subject to the disclosed file/storage limits. Cancelling does not retroactively remove a legitimately consumed creation allowance or automatically refund a delivered paid period. A changed offer must be reviewed and accepted again before a new purchase; legitimate non-delivery, incorrect charges and non-excludable remedies remain available. A risk reserve is not a consumer refund and does not prevent an eligible buyer remedy.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect information needed to provide your account, digital orders and customer support:
• Account and contact details: Your name, email address, mobile/contact number and any optional profile details you provide. Authentication credentials are handled by the configured authentication service, including Supabase; passwords are not kept as readable text.
• Order and payment records: Purchased items, order IDs, payment references, amounts, payment status and timestamps.
• Download and security records: Available file-access events, download-link creation, IP addresses, user-agent information and timestamps used for security and order support.
• Communications: Contact-form messages, emails, WhatsApp messages and support records you send to us.
• Product updates: Your email and subscription record if you separately choose to subscribe to updates.
• Creator onboarding: public storefront name, bio and listings; private legal, identity, tax, payout and provider-onboarding details where needed. Sensitive payout details are encrypted with server-held keys and are not included in public profiles.
• Subscriptions: plan, renewal mode, mandate/provider references, verified paid periods, cancellation and billing history. We do not store bank mandate secrets or UPI PINs.
• Seller-only KYC: PAN, legal/tax details and registered bank/approved payout information needed for seller onboarding. Ordinary buyer registration/purchase does not require PAN. A format check is not identity verification. Any additional identity document must be requested only for a necessary, approved verification purpose through the private workflow.
• Product handling: product archives, source file URLs submitted for a supported import, private staging/review records and file safety/size metadata.
• Risk and reserves: affected orders, risk reasons, review dates, dispute records, notices and provider release/settlement references. These records distinguish internal eligibility, provider acceptance and confirmed bank settlement.

sections.content: We use essential session cookies and local browser storage to keep you logged in, save items in your shopping cart/wishlist, and maintain secure navigation. We do not use intrusive cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.title: 4. Payment Processing & Service Providers
sections.content:
Payment information is entered on the payment provider’s checkout, including Cashfree, Razorpay and Easebuzz where enabled. BooyahMarket does not ask for or store card security codes (CVV), UPI PINs, banking passwords or payment OTPs. Necessary transaction references and payment status are retained to verify orders and provide support.

We share only the data necessary to operate the store with service providers for authentication and data storage (including Supabase), hosting (including Vercel), transactional email (including Resend), and payment processing (including Cashfree, Razorpay, Easebuzz and the original processor for an existing order). These services may process data outside your region according to their service terms and privacy practices. They are not appointed as alternative owners or grievance contacts for BooyahMarket.

For approved marketplace payments, necessary seller identity/payout details and the order’s split amounts are provided to the selected provider for onboarding, verification, settlement and compliance. A creator sees only the order information needed to fulfill and support their own sales; they cannot see another creator’s orders or private KYC. Relevant transaction and evidence records may be supplied to the original provider for a dispute. We never send customer passwords, service keys, UPI PINs or all customers’ data as payment metadata.

Seller PAN and required legal/payout information are encrypted in the server-side Supabase database and are not public profile fields. Necessary seller information may be sent to the selected provider and its authorized verification/banking partners for the approved onboarding, tax, payout or compliance purpose. Submission does not mean that all three gateways receive every seller’s complete KYC. Public business disclosures have a separate publication consent. A seller can see the status of their own onboarding; they cannot view another seller’s private KYC.

Product ZIP files are held in private Supabase Storage for validation/review and authorized delivery. A supported direct-link import retrieves only the permitted file into private storage; the submitted URL is not itself a buyer download entitlement. Storage region and infrastructure processing follow the actually configured project/provider settings; we do not claim a particular physical location without that configuration being confirmed.

sections.title: 5. Purposes of Data Processing & Email Communications
sections.content:
We use personal data to:
• Create and protect your account.
• Verify payments and provide your purchased downloads and receipts.
• Send account, security, order, refund and download-related emails.
• Respond to support requests and grievances.
• Prevent fraud, unauthorized sharing and abuse.
• Send optional product updates if you separately subscribe; you can ask us to stop these updates. Transactional and security messages remain necessary for your account and purchases.

We do not sell, rent or trade personal data to third parties for marketing.

sections.title: 6. Data Security, Safeguards & Retention
sections.content:
We use TLS for service connections, server-held encryption keys for private seller identity/payout fields, private file storage, limited service-role access and masked public/admin status views. Full PAN or bank data must not be placed in public URLs, browser storage, product metadata, analytics, email attachments or routine logs. Providers may separately retain verification records under their legal obligations. No system is represented as immune to every security incident.

We retain only information needed for account service, seller verification, tax/accounting, payment support, fraud prevention, disputes and legal obligations. A 120-day risk review target is not a universal KYC deletion period or permission to keep every document forever. We review continued need and handle access/correction/deletion requests through the named grievance contact, subject to required retention and account-holder verification.

sections.title: 7. Record Sharing for Dispute Minimisation
sections.content: In the event of a payment dispute, fraud investigation, or legal inquiry, relevant transaction records (such as IP logs, order confirmations, and download timestamps) may be shared with payment processors, banks, or law enforcement agencies as required by applicable law.

sections.title: 8. Your Choices, Rights & Grievance Support
sections.content:
You may view or update available account details by signing in, or contact connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com to request access, correction or deletion of your personal information. We may need to verify that the request comes from the account holder. Records required for payment, tax, accounting, fraud prevention or legal obligations may need to be retained even when an account is deleted.

sections.title: Eligibility & Accurate Information
sections.content:
You must be at least 18, legally able to contract, and authorized to publish and sell each product. Normal buyers use the email/password account flow and are not required to submit PAN as a condition of an ordinary digital purchase. PAN format submission alone is not completed government/provider KYC. Platform moderation approval, private KYC submission and provider-verified payout activation are separate states. Public seller business/support/grievance disclosures are supplied and consented separately; we do not expose PAN, bank account details or identity-document images in public storefronts.

No infringing, illegal, malicious, deceptive or prohibited products may be published.

sections.title: Prices, Commission & Payouts
sections.content:
For an independent creator sale, the platform commission is a flat ₹20 per successfully paid digital item, recorded in paise with the order; digital products are purchased once per item per order. For example, two paid items have a ₹40 platform commission. This platform fee is separate from the creator-plan subscription. Any applicable provider charges, taxes, lawful deductions and their treatment must be disclosed through the approved arrangement; they are not described as included in ₹20 unless explicitly stated. An item cannot create a negative seller allocation. A coupon or price that cannot support the recorded allocation must be corrected before checkout. Confirmed refunds, reversals and lost disputes adjust the affected allocation under the original order and provider rules. No record may claim a bank credit merely because a payable balance exists.

For eligible independent-creator proceeds, our standard target is release eligibility 3 calendar days (72 hours) after the verified successful live payment and digital access have been provided. The review window helps us check delivery issues, payment disputes and complaints. It is not a promise that every dispute appears within three days or that no later chargeback can occur.

Settlement is handled through the payment provider’s approved marketplace/split arrangement. Where an approved hold-and-release API is activated, scheduled processing can request release after eligibility; otherwise the case requires the supported provider-dashboard process. We do not claim to operate a customer wallet, bank account or escrow service in our own capacity. Provider, legal, KYC, refund and risk restrictions take precedence over our target. A release request, a ledger entry and a provider-accepted transfer are distinct from confirmed bank credit. Bank holidays, provider cutoffs, outages and beneficiary checks can extend arrival time. Bank settlement goes to the seller’s verified registered payout account. UPI payout is available only if the separately approved provider product supports and verifies that destination; it is not a simultaneous second payment of the same proceeds.

You remain responsible for applicable tax registration, accurate tax details and seller invoicing/reporting obligations. The platform payment receipt is not automatically a GST tax invoice.

sections.title: Buyer Support, Refunds & Memberships
sections.content: Provide the advertised, safe and functional files, assist with genuine delivery/description issues, and cooperate promptly with platform support, eligible refunds and disputes. Never request a buyer’s password, UPI PIN, payment OTP or card security code. Honor the published license and paid membership periods. Cancellation of your plan or suspension of new sales must not erase valid prior orders or authorized download rights. The platform’s published consumer refund and grievance policies also apply.

sections.title: Moderation, Records & Disputes
sections.content:
Listings, product rights and private files are subject to review. Only server-verified live payments create sale entitlements or payable proceeds. Available payment, email, download-authorization, support and acceptance records may be shared with the original provider for a genuine dispute. A generated download link or email-provider acceptance does not prove a completed download or payment authorization.

Credible excessive chargebacks, suspected illegal products, identity/payment irregularities or a legal complaint can trigger a documented review. We may pause the affected listings or new sales and restrict the affected seller’s access where justified. A complaint alone is not a finding of guilt, and an open dispute is not automatically a proven fraud. Ordinary buyer purchase accounts are not required to provide seller PAN merely because they bought a product.

Where our approved provider arrangement and applicable law permit a reserve, the affected/proportionate unsettled exposure may be placed under review with an initial target review period of up to 120 calendar days from the restriction. The recorded case identifies the reason, affected amount/orders, start date, target review date and next action; we communicate the reason and review/appeal route unless law or a binding provider instruction prevents disclosure. The seller can submit evidence or challenge an error through the published support/grievance contact. We review the need for the restriction rather than treating 120 days as an automatic penalty or confiscation.

Expiry triggers a review of outstanding refunds, chargebacks, legal instructions and KYC requirements. If the issues are resolved and the provider permits release, the eligible balance can enter the provider-approved release process. An unresolved binding legal/provider hold does not disappear on day 120; a longer restriction needs a documented basis, updated review date and notice where permitted. We do not guarantee an automatic bank transfer exactly on day 120. Amounts no longer needed for a justified restriction should be released through the approved route. No arbitrary fine or forfeiture of all seller earnings is created by this policy.

A local review flag cannot hold or reverse money already settled to a bank. Any provider recovery, transfer reversal or further reserve requires its actual approved process and is recorded separately.

sections.title: Changes & Ending Participation
sections.content: You may stop submitting new listings and contact support to close your storefront. Existing payment obligations, dispute cooperation, buyer rights, refunds, licenses and legally required records survive closure. New fees or material terms apply prospectively with notice and any consent required by law. The terms do not waive non-excludable consumer rights. sections.title: Creator Plans & Product Allowances
sections.content:
Creator plans are ₹499 per month for up to 10 new product creations in each verified paid monthly billing period, or ₹899 per month with no product-count limit. The ₹499 plan includes the published storefront, secure product delivery, order management and basic earnings tools; the ₹899 plan includes the available seller tools and customer-membership offer creation. It does not grant platform-admin access. A product created as a draft counts toward the 10-product allowance; deleting, archiving or replacing it does not restore that period’s allowance. A renewed verified paid period has its own allowance. Existing order and subscription snapshots remain tied to the offer accepted at purchase.

Unlimited refers to product count, not unlimited storage, bandwidth or file size. Each product archive is limited to 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes), and the disclosed available storage and technical limits still apply. The price, features, interval, renewal mode and any applicable taxes or mandatory charges are shown before payment. We do not sell a provider approval or a guarantee of sales as a plan benefit.

sections.title: Private Files & Direct-Link Imports
sections.content:
Product archives must be ZIP files no larger than 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes). Uploads are sent directly to private Supabase Storage using a short-lived authorized upload route, then checked server-side and held for review. Approved product delivery uses the private product area and short-lived account-authorized download links; files are not published as open website assets.

A seller may instead submit an eligible public HTTPS direct file link through the supported import flow. The link is subject to host/network safety checks, file-type and actual-size checks, timeout limits and private copying before review. Login pages, ordinary web pages, link shorteners, private/internal network addresses, unsafe redirects and files over the limit are not accepted. Submitting an external URL is not approval, delivery or a download entitlement. Do not submit another person’s private files or credentials. Neither a paid plan nor a direct link bypasses ownership, content review, file limits or available storage capacity.

sections.title: Prohibited & Restricted Products
sections.content:
This marketplace is for lawful, rights-cleared digital products within the approved business category. You must not list, upload, sell, link to or use the checkout to facilitate:
• Pirated, cracked, stolen or unauthorized copyrighted software/media, license keys, copied templates, circumvention tools, counterfeits or another creator’s paid package without sufficient rights.
• Malware, ransomware, phishing kits, credential theft, unauthorized hacking/access tools, stolen accounts, passwords, government identity documents, personal-data dumps or mailing lists; bulk-spam tools and unsolicited-message products.
• Child sexual abuse/exploitation material, pornography or sexually explicit services, trafficking, abusive or unlawful hate/violence content, and material that violates another person’s privacy or safety.
• Weapons, ammunition, explosives, illegal drugs or controlled substances, body parts, prohibited wildlife products, alcohol/tobacco or other physical/regulated goods outside this digital-only store.
• Gambling, betting, real-money gaming or chance-based paid schemes; deceptive prize/mystery-box schemes, money laundering, pyramid/MLM collection fees, get-rich-quick or fraudulent investment/earnings claims.
• Unlicensed financial, lending, investment, money-transfer, currency/crypto or stored-value/gift-card products; regulated advice or other services for which the required authorization and provider approval have not been established.
• Fake qualifications/certificates, identity impersonation, deceptive job-placement or paid-employment promises, unsubstantiated medical/miracle-cure claims, or other fraudulent or unlawful products.

This is a platform restriction list, not a statement that every named category is illegal in every context. Provider restrictions may prohibit a lawful category or require separate written approval. Cashfree, Razorpay and Easebuzz have their own current negative/restricted categories and submerchant rules. The stricter applicable legal/provider/platform rule governs a sale. Changing gateways does not make a rejected category acceptable, and generic payment-gateway activation does not approve digital downloads, third-party aggregation or recurring products. Ask support before listing an uncertain category. A licence or open-source permission must actually cover the proposed sale; legitimate third-party components may retain their own notices and permissions.
